title: Drive and Notion sync
intro: Keep selected cloud documents in your chatbot's knowledge. Changes and removals are checked every 15 minutes.
privacy: Only selected Drive folders and Notion pages are imported. Use read-only access and share documents suitable for customer answers. Pausing hides imported knowledge immediately. Refreshes expire after 24 hours without a successful sync.
loadError: Could not load connections. Refresh to try again.
actionError: Could not complete the action. Check your input and try again.
label: Connection name
readOnly: This Notion connection has Read content permission only.
driveHelp: Select up to 5 folders. Copy the ID after /folders/ in each folder's URL. Nested folders are included within the documented limits. Docs, Sheets and Slides are exported automatically.
notionHelp: Share up to 20 chosen pages with your Notion connection, then copy each page ID from its URL. Select child pages separately. Truncated or unsupported page content needs review.
notConfigured: Ask your platform administrator to configure Google Drive authorization.
replace: One connection per provider. To change the account, credentials or selected content, disconnect and connect again.
disconnectPrompt: Disconnect and delete all knowledge imported by this connection?
syncError: Sync failed. Check sharing permissions, selected content and connection access. Reconnect if authorization changed. Large or incomplete documents may exceed sync limits.
sheetRefresh: Refresh this imported spreadsheet from Drive and Notion sync.
